svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Batch broadcast sending through Postmark
svg.desc: Broadcast delivery moves from one Postmark request per recipient to batched requests of 500, with suppression filtering pulled in front of the send and the payload builder extracted into a shared library.
